text:
emma-support: Heard from AcmeCorp and BetaShop — Console graphs are coming up blank and panels spin forever. Customer ticket references analytics API returning 500s starting ~09:10 UTC. Can someone triage?

alex-eng: Do we have a sample request id or a curl? Any recent deploys?

emma-support: Repro steps I followed: open Console -> Usage -> set time range to last 30d -> all graph panels show spinner. Sample curl that failed: 
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer xxxxx\" \"https://api.redwood.example/internal/analytics/query?panel=usage_timeseries&from=2026-03-16T00:00:00Z&to=2026-03-17T09:00:00Z\"
> GET /internal/analytics/query?... HTTP/1.1
< HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
< X-Request-Id: 3f6a7b2c
< Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"error\": \"internal server error\"
}
```

deploy-bot: analytics-api deployed by @alex-eng to prod at 2026-03-17T09:12:30Z (deploy id: dpl-78321).

marta-sre: I'm seeing a surge in analytics-api 5xx at the same window. Upstream to chproxy shows timeouts/502s. chproxy logs include repeated: \"timeout waiting for result from ClickHouse, query_id=qh-9a1b\" and ClickHouse is returning 504 for heavy queries.

nate-analytics: Checked ClickHouse metrics — ch-01 has merge_queue_size spiking and io_wait elevated; several long-running SELECTs from the reindex job kicked off hourly. Query id from logs: qh-9a1b. Those queries are dominating worker threads.

alex-eng: Can we get the analytics-api logs for request id 3f6a7b2c? Also did the deploy coincide with the reindex job?

marta-sre: Paste from analytics-api stderr for 3f6a7b2c: 
```
2026-03-17T09:14:05Z ERROR handler.go:142 request_id=3f6a7b2c upstream_error=\"clickhouse timeout\" path=/internal/analytics/query status=500
2026-03-17T09:14:05Z WARN proxy.go:88 downstream_latency=2340ms upstream_latency=2305ms
```

nate-analytics: Confirmed internal reindex job started at 09:10 UTC (job id: reidx-20260317-0910). It launched a full-materialized view refresh across large tables. That plus a traffic spike to Console panels pushed ClickHouse over capacity.

emma-support: Impacted customers reported: AcmeCorp (ticket 9876), BetaShop (ticket 9901). ETA for fix? Customers are asking.

marta-sre: Immediate mitigation: I increased chproxy replicas from 2 -> 4 and scaled ClickHouse consumer threads. Still seeing some queue, but analytics-api 500s dropped after I restarted a chproxy pod (rolled one). I also temporarily disabled the reindex job at 09:28 UTC.

alex-eng: I restarted the analytics-api pod at 09:31 UTC to clear in-flight. After restart, Console panels started to recover for me at ~09:35 UTC.

nate-analytics: Confirmed: metrics show 5xx rate fell from 12% -> 0.6% in 10m. ClickHouse merge queue backed down after reindex was stopped.

emma-support: I updated both customer tickets with a status update and apology. Will follow up when root cause is finalized.

marta-sre: Root cause summary for postmortem: non-throttled full reindex job coincided with regular Console traffic. Lack of query prioritization and chproxy replica count too low for peak memory/IO footprint. Mitigations: (1) gate reindex with concurrency limit (PR open), (2) add ClickHouse and analytics-api alerts for merge_queue_size and 5xx rate > 1%, (3) increase chproxy replicas in autoscale policy, (4) add graceful degradation on heavy queries (limit time_range for dashboard panels).

nate-analytics: I'll attach the PRs: agents/reindex-gating#45 and infra/chproxy-autoscale#22. Also scheduling a runbook for SRE: how to throttle/kill reindex safely.

alex-eng: Thanks team. Action items: nate -> PR for gating, marta -> add alerting and update runbook, ops -> review chproxy autoscale config. Emma -> send final customer note after postmortem.

emma-support: Sending final customer note now. Marking thread resolved for support after follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
